tried: https://doi.org/10.1136/injuryprev-2019-043484 in the built-in browser: injuryprevention.bmj.com showed a 'Performing security verification' page for about 25 seconds and did not clear; no challenge was attempted and the BMJ article page was not read.

Fetching https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/7571364/bin/injuryprev-2019-043484supp003.pdf from script returns an HTTP 200 text/html reCAPTCHA 'Checking your browser' page, not the PDF; navigating a real browser tab to the same address passed the automatic check and served the 107 KB PDF, whose text was then extracted with pdf.js inside the page.
notes: VERDICT ON 9,155: it does not appear anywhere in supplementary table S1 (all four pages searched for '9 155', '9,155' and '9155'). The table prints no row labelled 'Europe' or 'European Region'; the European groupings are the three GBD regions and the two super-regions recorded as rows. So the esanum figure has no origin in GBD 2017's regional table either. The supplementary file's running title is '08 Appendix Table 1 - deaths pct change' and its first line is a BMJ disclaimer that the material was supplied by the authors. Values were transcribed from text extracted by pdf.js and cross-read against the table layout (value line, label line, interval line); the global row (295 210; 284 493 to 306 187; 4.0; 3.8 to 4.1) matched the ledger's existing rows, which is the check that the extraction was aligned. The five deaths rows and three rate rows are the groupings the task asked for; country rows for European countries are in the same table and were not transcribed.
